subject.title: Add session workspace file preview editing

question: Should OpenClaw core accept an admin-scoped `sessions.files.set` RPC that can create or overwrite UTF-8 text files under a resolved session workspace root after this branch is ported to current main?
rationale: The code path is a new core Gateway write surface and security boundary; automation can check scopes and fs-safe usage, but cannot decide whether this write capability belongs in core with this breadth.

options.title: Accept admin-only session file saves
options.body: Port the PR to current main, keep `operator.admin`, and require the existing fs-safe/conflict tests to cover the accepted write boundary.

options.title: Narrow the write surface
options.body: Require a patch that limits saves to a maintainer-approved subset, such as touched or previewed text files, before merge.

options.title: Defer core editing
options.body: Close or pause the PR if session workspace editing should move to a separate product/API direction instead of core Control UI now.

recommendation.title: Accept admin-only session file saves
recommendation.body: Port the PR to current main, keep `operator.admin`, and require the existing fs-safe/conflict tests to cover the accepted write boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on the current session workspace viewer and shared workspace-fs helper makes this the best available owner for the port and write-boundary decision.
